checks.source: Akiki E, Arghami A, Abbasi MA, El-Am EA, Ahmad A, Foley TA (2024). Case Report: A myxoma with a far reach. Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine.

source_fit_rows.source_population: 73-year-old woman presenting to a US emergency department (Mayo Clinic, Minnesota) with syncope and a history of dizzy spells ultimately attributed to a left atrial myxoma
source_fit_rows.family_population: spouse describing a 42-year-old male US factory worker with heavy sweating, a brief dizzy spell, and a 105 F oral temperature after 4 hours on a hot factory floor
source_fit_rows.note: Both are US emergency clinical presentations using colloquial 'dizzy spell(s)' (matching core entry 'spell' in dialect_lexicon_20261109.json), adapted from a 73-year-old woman with cardiac syncope and 'dizzy spells' to singular 'dizzy spell' in a 42-year-old factory worker with exertional hyperthermia.
